newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco do Brasil, IBM to sign software deal.
newsitem.headline: Banco do Brasil, IBM to sign software deal.

text.p: Brazil's state-owned Banco do Brasil said it will sign Friday a preliminary deal with International Business Machines Corp to buy new software to automate branches and modernize its basic software.
A Banco do Brasil spokesman said the contract involves a total investment of $13 million until 2000.
The preliminary contract, called a protocol, also includes the creation of a software development and technology center in Brasilia, a bank statement said.

The protocol is slated to be signed at 1100 local/1400 GMT in bank offices in Brasilia by bank President Paulo Ximenes and IBM president for software worldwide Stanley J. Krasnow, as well as other bank and company officials, the statement said.
